task_instance: Inspiration/adapt mode: given a small sample Expo (SDK 54, expo-router) user project with no camera feature, find and study the 'with-camera' example from expo/examples, then non-destructively port its camera-capture pattern into the user's app: add only the missing dependencies (SDK-correct versions via `EXPO_OFFLINE=1 npx expo install`), merge the app.json plugin list (add expo-image, keep expo-router), and port the integration code as a new app/camera.tsx screen, verifying it all type-checks together.
evidence: Work dir: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_gr/expo__skills__expo-examples@developer-sandbox/user-app. `gh api` for expo/examples was blocked ('GitHub access to this repository is not enabled for this session... use add_repo'), which is a forbidden repository-attachment path per the safety rules, so I used the skill's documented fallback instead: `git clone --depth 1 --filter=blob:none --sparse https://github.com/expo/examples.git` then `git sparse-checkout set with-camera` (into a throwaway ref/ dir, deleted afterward), and confirmed via meta.json that with-camera is not deprecated/aliased. Read README.md, package.json, app.json, App.tsx of the example. Created a minimal sample user app (package.json with expo ~54.0.0 + expo-router, app.json, app/index.tsx). Ran `npm install` (868 packages) to establish baseline. `npx expo install expo-camera expo-image @expo/vector-icons` initially failed because it needs api.expo.dev which the sandbox's proxy allowlist blocks (403); retried with `EXPO_OFFLINE=1 npx expo install ...` which succeeded and added SDK-54-correct versions (expo-camera ~17.0.10, expo-image ~3.0.11, @expo/vector-icons ^15.0.3) to package.json/node_modules, matching the skill's 'version-align, don't copy pinned versions' rule. Merged app.json plugins array to add 'expo-image' while keeping the user's existing 'expo-router' entry. Copied the example's App.tsx to app/camera.tsx and renamed the default export to CameraScreen (only file added, index.tsx untouched). Installed @types/react (missing from the toy project, unrelated to the ported code) then ran `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json`, which completed with zero errors, verifying the ported integration compiles cleanly against the merged dependency/config set. Final files: user-app/package.json, user-app/app.json, user-app/app/camera.tsx, user-app/app/index.tsx.
